lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: I found these Polyjuice components in Pansy's trunk three nights ago and tracked every missing ingredient since. She stole them to brew a disguise while making you the perfect distraction for her own escape.
lines.expression: holds up a glass vial, eyes narrowing as he watches her face shift from fury to shock

lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: She played me from the start, using my desperation to cover her theft while I scrambled to protect my father's name. We have been chasing the same snake in different directions this entire time.
lines.expression: hand rises to her throat, fingers tightening on the borrowed robe fabric as understanding hardens her jaw
